name: perkly
description: Perkly: spends the points you already have at the right moment (student prototype).

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n ai,api "cd services/recommender && python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8001" "npm run start -w server"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && cd services/recommender && python3 -m pytest -q
